design_description:
A sleek Las Vegas-inspired black design, combining a clean upper body with an intricate illustrated skyline wrapping around the lower jersey. The cityscape features iconic Vegas architecture, palm trees and subtle playing-card suit motifs, using dark grey with sharp red and gold highlights.

Gold typography and branding give the front a premium casino feel, while thin gold-and-red trim finishes the collar and cuffs. The back continues the skyline beneath a large gold player name and number, keeping the theme consistent front to back.
